head: ddf482a6
headSubject: fix: build idp-google/idp-github jars for packaged-proof runs (SEC-11 gap)
summary: Resumed the prior handoff's NEXT item (NPDevCli Linux coverage signal blocked by a red 'NPDev CI Validation' workflow) and, chasing that one blocker, found and fixed FOUR distinct real bugs each verified green in live CI, one layer at a time: (1) MinIO deleted minio/minio from Docker Hub 2026-09-11 and its quay.io mirror also stopped anonymous pulls -- repointed the S3-compatible test double and DockerDeploymentEmitter's bundled objectstore compose service to LocalStack instead (commits 91527c81/ff20cb64/e1499cea); (2) PigmentampasSampleTest's pack resolution only ever worked on Marcelo's own machine (npdev.lock's sourcePath/digest hardcoded his machine, and checkLock does strict string-equality against the live path) -- added a @BeforeAll that populates the pack cache from NPDevContract/packs/<id>/pack.json directly and self-heals npdev.lock before parsing (c8e82b6a), also fixing a real digest drift traced to REG-164's exact failure mode one level removed; (3) SEC-11's OAuthGoogleController (2026-09-16) was never added to the three packaged-proof tests' adapter-jar build lists, so runtimehost-core failed to compile on any clean machine -- added idp-google/idp-github to all three lists and corrected AdapterRegistrationConsistencyTest's KNOWN_NOT_PACKAGED exclusion that had encoded the same wrong assumption (ddf482a6). Each fix was verified by watching the actual CI run to completion before moving to the next layer, not assumed. Separately diagnosed (not fixed, needs Marcelo's own browser) the Dependabot PR mechanism: dependabot.yml's updates:[] is not the leak -- GitHub is still firing pre-existing per-directory update registrations from before the 2026-08-29 disable, with no REST/API lever found; only fix is the web UI at Insights -> Dependency graph -> Dependabot.
nextStep: CI has now progressed further than it has since 2026-09-12, and each layer removed reveals the next: a large new failure surfaced in 'RuntimeHost generated-app Postgres integration tests' (shared root cause: MissingTableCreationPass -> PSQLException, looks like a schema-realization issue affecting many ITs at once) -- investigate that next. Also still unresolved: never located where NPDevCli's actual coverage number gets measured in NPDev CI Validation at all ('Portable NPDev CLI smoke' is a functional smoke test, not a coverage run) -- the original coverage-ratchet question from the prior handoff may need its own investigation even after CI is fully green. And the Dependabot per-directory registrations still need Marcelo to manually disable them at https://github.com/MarceloGiazzon/NPDevGeneral/network/updates (or Settings -> Code security -> Dependabot) since no CLI/API lever exists.
blocked: Dependabot per-directory update registrations: confirmed via direct GitHub registry/API checks (quay.io anonymous pull genuinely denied, corroborated by two identical live CI timeouts) and via gh api that no REST/API field exists for the underlying per-directory 'Dependabot version updates' toggle -- needs Marcelo's own browser action, cannot be done via CLI.
verified: Confirmed live via 'gh run watch' on each successive push, not assumed: 91527c81/ff20cb64 each still failed (NotFoundException then IllegalStateException) -- iterating in place taught the exact fix each time. e1499cea: 'Kernel Docker-backed adapter tests (non-Postgres)' green for the first time this whole investigation. c8e82b6a: PigmentampasSampleTest passed inside the real :generator:test run (572 tests) for the first time ever in CI; also locally verified end-to-end against a genuinely empty NPDEV_PACK_CACHE_ROOT simulating a fresh runner, both before and after finding the correct digests. ddf482a6: all 4 packaged-proof tests green, 'Portable NPDev CLI smoke' green, 'Stage RuntimeHost libs' and 'Generate RuntimeHost sample app' green -- run 36643580142. Local compile + AdapterRegistrationConsistencyTest guard also run and green before each push. gh pr list confirms 0 open PRs; git status clean at session end.
